analysis.purpose: The default derived search index: SQLite with FTS5 full-text ranking plus a materialized adjacency table, so impact and neighbour queries are graph walks over indexed edges rather than scans.
responsibilities: Build the searchable index from the soul, rehydrating each node span from disk
Serve keyword ranking over names, signatures and source bodies
Answer impact, neighbours and shortest-path as indexed adjacency walks
Apply the source redaction policy before any text enters the index

businessRules.rule: The full-text body column is search-only: body text is never returned by a query and lives only in the derived index, never in the soul.
businessRules.rationale: Keeps the soul lean while letting a search match rule content rather than only names.

businessRules.rule: A deny policy blocks the disk read entirely, so a secret value can never be matched by full-text search.
businessRules.rationale: Secrets must not be reachable even indirectly through the index.
